slides.title: Interactive Components Overview
slides.content:
# Advanced & Interactive Components 📱🚀

Bootstrap 5 provides a powerful suite of JavaScript-driven interactive components. They can be initialized entirely via **HTML5 `data-bs-*` attributes** or programmatically via the **Bootstrap JavaScript API**.

## Components in this Module:
- **Navbars & Navs**: Responsive mobile drawer menus and tabbed interfaces
- **Modals**: Accessible dialog boxes and lightbox overlays
- **Carousels**: Slideshow banners with controls, indicators, and touch swiping
- **Accordions**: Accessible expanding/collapsing FAQ panels
- **Dropdowns**: Popover action menus
- **Tooltips & Popovers**: Contextual information balloons
- **Offcanvas**: Sliding sidebar drawers for mobile navigation

slides.title: The Responsive Navbar
slides.content:
# The Responsive Navbar 🧭 The Bootstrap Navbar is a responsive navigation wrapper that collapses into a hamburger menu on smaller screens. ```html_not
DevSphere
  • Home
  • Docs
  • Pricing
```

slides.title: Navbar Anatomy: Toggler & Expand
slides.content:
# Navbar Breakpoints & Anatomy ⚙️

## The `.navbar-expand-{breakpoint}` Rule

- `.navbar-expand-lg`: Expands horizontally on `lg` (>= 992px); collapses into hamburger menu below `992px`.
- `.navbar-expand-md`: Collapses below `768px`.
- `.navbar-expand`: Never collapses (always desktop horizontal).

## Color Schemes

- `.navbar-light`: For light backgrounds (dark text/icon)
- `.navbar-dark`: For dark backgrounds (light text/icon)

slides.title: Tooltips & Popovers (Popper.js)
slides.content:
# Tooltips & Popovers 🎈

For performance reasons, Tooltips and Popovers are **opt-in** and must be initialized via JavaScript!

## HTML Markup

```html_not
<button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-toggle="tooltip" data-bs-placement="top" title="Tooltip text">
  Hover Me
</button>
```

## JavaScript Initialization Script

```javascript_not
// Initialize all tooltips on page
const tooltipTriggerList = document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]');
const tooltipList = [...tooltipTriggerList].map(el => new bootstrap.Tooltip(el));
```

slides.title: JavaScript Best Practices in Bootstrap 5
slides.content:
# JavaScript Best Practices in Bootstrap 5 💡

1. **Include `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`**: Always use the bundle because it includes Popper.js (required for dropdowns, tooltips, and popovers).
2. **Use `bootstrap.Modal.getInstance()`**: Check if an instance exists before calling `new bootstrap.Modal()` to prevent multiple overlapping instances.
3. **Clean up listeners**: Dispose of instances with `.dispose()` in Single Page Applications (React/Vue) when unmounting components.

slides.title: Summary: Interactive Components
slides.content:
# Interactive Components: Summary 📋

## Key Takeaways
- **Navbar**: Collapsible responsive navigation bar (`.navbar-expand-lg`).
- **Modals**: Accessible dialog boxes controlled via `data-bs-toggle="modal"` or JS API.
- **Carousels**: Slide presentations with autoplay intervals and indicators.
- **Accordions**: Mutual exclusion panels configured via `data-bs-parent`.
- **Offcanvas**: Mobile drawer navigation sliding from start/end.
- **Popper Components**: Dropdowns, Tooltips, and Popovers require Popper.
